You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

We continuously screen the security of your entire IT infrastructure. 

You are here: 
Home 
Solutions 
Cybersecurity 
SOC as a Service 

Our Security Operation Centre protects your information security 
Do you want to be protected against hacking and detect attacks at an early state so that you can initiate targeted countermeasures? We work with cybersecurity experts to keep on safeguarding your systems and data. 
Our Security Operations Centre (SOC) is the ideal solution for your information security. It delivers the central technology for recording and analysing log files so that the entire infrastructure can be monitored round the clock. Apart from using rule-based approaches, it can also analyse trends and patterns in order to detect deviations and so attacks on your infrastructure. Numerous technologies from our portfolio are supported as part of that, including Active Directory, Windows servers, Linux servers, SAP systems and web applications. 
Connecting systems to an SOC makes it possible to detect and contain any spreads or actual compromises more quickly than is the case with an IT security architecture that is not as networked. We also provide regular metrics and reports on the current security situation so that your systems’ IT security and the current threat situation are measurable for you. 
Contact us now 

Your advantages: 
24/7 protection and monitoring of your system’s security status 
Centralised storage and interpretation of the collected event data 
Rapid detection of security incidents 
Customising of the detection rules to enable all-round, worry-free protection 
Complete visibility on user activities in your own network 
Regular reporting on the status of IT security and the current threat situation 
Fulfilment of compliance requirements and statutory regulations
